_comment: Minimal config — read tools need NO env at all. macOS/Linux: command 'dexe-mcp'. Windows: if the shim is not on PATH, use { "command": "node", "args": ["<npm root -g>/dexe-mcp/dist/index.js"] } — `npx dexe-mcp init` prints that exact snippet for you. The _-prefixed keys below are documentation; delete them if your MCP client rejects unknown top-level keys.
_env_note: Put DEXE_* values in ~/.dexe-mcp/.env (written by `npx dexe-mcp init`), NOT in the env block — a key set in the client config SHADOWS the .env file silently. Run `npx dexe-mcp doctor` to see which file was loaded and what is shadowed.
_signing_note: No private key is needed to BUILD transactions. To let the server broadcast, connect a wallet with dexe_wc_connect (WalletConnect) — a plaintext DEXE_PRIVATE_KEY is the last resort, see docs/SETUP.md.

_optional_env.DEXE_PINATA_JWT: <your Pinata JWT — only needed to CREATE DAOs/proposals>
